# ffxf_vms (Data Source)

Lists FFXF Cloud virtual machines, optionally filtered by status, region, and billing mode.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_vms" "all" {
  status  = "running"
  region  = "montreal"
  billing = "hourly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing` (String) Filter by billing mode, hourly or monthly.
- `region` (String) Filter by region slug.
- `status` (String) Filter by VM lifecycle status.

### Read-Only

- `vms` (Attributes List) Virtual machines matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `billing_mode` (String) Hourly or monthly billing mode.
- `hostname` (String) VM hostname.
- `id` (Number) Stable numeric VM ID.
- `image` (String) Installed image slug.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address, if assigned.
- `ipv6` (String) Public IPv6 address, if assigned.
- `plan` (String) Plan slug.
- `region` (String) Region slug.
- `status` (String) Current VM status.
